name: vault-mcp
description: Production-grade MCP server for Obsidian vaults — hybrid search, capture pipeline, backlink-aware operations

overrides._overrides_rationale: Floors for transitive deps that bun audit flags, each caret-bounded to the major its parent already accepts. js-yaml ^4.3.2: transitive deps pull in 3.x (code execution via untrusted YAML) and <=4.1.1 has merge-key/omap CPU DoS. qs ^6.16.0: prototype pollution and array-limit/isBuffer DoS in older versions. hono ^4.12.34 and @hono/node-server ^1.19.15 (via @modelcontextprotocol/sdk): CORS, body-limit, serve-static and SSR advisories; stays within the SDK's ^1 adapter range. ip-address ^10.3.1 (via express-rate-limit): SSRF/trust-boundary misclassification. proxy-addr ^2.0.8 (via express): IP spoofing through IPv4-mapped IPv6 trust subnets. fast-uri ^3.1.6 (via ajv): host confusion and SSRF in URI normalization. brace-expansion ^5.0.8 and smol-toml ^1.7.1 (dev only, via type-coverage and knip): DoS on crafted input.
